name: Brush with Temptation
source:
Riku Hayase didn't come from a famous school. He spent a year retaking the entrance exam to get into Shiratori Academy of Art, the best art school in the country. He's brilliant with a pencil and weak with colour, because his family could never afford art prep school. When he's nervous, he recites painters' names and life stories to calm down.

On his first day he gets hit in the face with a sketchbook. The girl who threw it is about to place first in the Placement Test. Then he finds out she's his roommate.

Rin Tsukishiro — “Ice Queen Tsukishiro”. A colour genius who mixes every colour she needs from three primaries and white, and so shy she blushes faster than she can turn a page. The only thing between their beds is a curtain… and a growing list of roommate rules written on pink sticky notes.

And then there's life drawing class.

[From the [url=https://brush.ottergonstudio.com/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
早濑陆并非名校出身。为了考入全国顶尖的艺术学府——白鸟美术学院，他复读了整整一年。由于家境拮据、上不起美术补习班，他的铅笔素描功底极强，色彩表现却成了短板。每当紧张时，他就会在心里默念著名画家的名字与生平来平复心情。

入学第一天，一本速写本迎面砸在了他的脸上。扔出本子的女孩即将在分班测试中夺得头名——紧接着早濑陆便得知，她竟是自己的室友。

月城凛——人称“冰之女王月城”。她是一位仅凭三原色与白色就能调出所需一切色彩的天才，本性却害羞得连翻一页画纸的工夫都会羞红了脸。两人床铺之间仅隔着一道帘子……以及贴满粉色便利贴、越列越长的室友守则。

不仅如此，接下来还有人体写生课。

[摘自[url=https://brush.ottergonstudio.com/#story]官方网站[/url]]
